data_safety.reason_not_permanent: The tuple sweep resets to the window head after reaching the tail, but relying on eventual reset would delay recovery and cannot prove completion of an aborted page.

root_cause.pre_fix_monitor_behavior: awaited the full nested deterministic scan before returning
root_cause.cost_driver: The source read/plan is fixed at 500 rows, while sequential per-case persistence work rises with the configured case cap. At cap 5 the awaited nested request crossed pg_net's fixed 5-second caller deadline.
root_cause.cursor_fault: The live sweep cursor was persisted immediately after reading each 250-row sweep page, before case accounting and health. Caller cancellation therefore left read-ahead cursor progress without completion proof.

selected_fix.monitor_request: Register the nested scan with EdgeRuntime.waitUntil and return the sync poll response without awaiting scan completion.
selected_fix.single_flight: Transfer the existing 10-minute mailbox lease to the continuation and release it only after settlement, so later two-minute polls exit locked rather than overlap.
selected_fix.scan_bound: The continuation remains bounded by the existing 500-source read cap, 1..10 case cap and attempt ceiling.
selected_fix.cursor_rule: Persist the cursor only after truthful run health. Rejected, thrown or cancelled runs retain the prior cursor and reread immediately. Completed degraded runs advance with an explicit retry-next-sweep caveat so one poison case cannot pin older pages.
selected_fix.reason: A larger fixed timeout only moves the failure threshold and still couples scheduler liveness to batch cost.
